title: Verdant deployment record
description: One deployment of the Verdant protocol: its addresses, the code actually running at them, and the settings that reproduce that code. Checked against the chain and against packages/config/src/deployments.ts by scripts/verify-deployment.ts.

deploymentBlock.description: The block the factory was created in. Where an indexer starts.

immutable.description: Whether this deployment has any upgrade path. Verdant's has none: replacing the protocol means a new record beside this one, and markets created under this one keep trading.

artifact.description: The Foundry broadcast file for this exact run. Named explicitly because the directory also holds local runs, and run-latest.json is not necessarily the live one.

contracts.description: The contracts of the deployment proper: wired to each other in immutables, deployed in the one order that works, replaceable only all at once.

addons.description: Contracts deployed beside a deployment rather than as part of one. An addon names nothing in the set above and nothing in it names the addon.

enabled.description: Whether the interface offers it. A deployed addon that is switched off is still published here, so that a contract found at that address can be read against something.

hookPermissions.description: Uniswap reads a hook's permissions from the low 14 bits of its own address, so the address is the permission and checking it requires no call.

checkedAt.description: When the hashes below were last confirmed against the chain.

runtimeCodeHash.description: The account's codeHash from the state trie, via eth_getProof. The chain's own hash of the deployed code, not one computed locally from bytes it returned.
